author: mdjermanovic
body:
Thank for the report, I can reproduce this.

This is definitely a bug in this rule, but not because of the invalid autofix. The rule should actually not report `function() {}` in `foo(function() {} ? a : b);` because the `function() {} ? a : b` expression cannot evaluate to `function() {}`, so it shouldn't be considered as an argument/callback. PR to fix this is welcome.
